mechanism: Ibuprofen may increase prochlorperazine levels via CYP450 inhibition and competition for protein binding, while prochlorperazine increases NSAID gastrointestinal toxicity risk through additive anticholinergic effects and reduced gastric protection.
action: Monitor for increased prochlorperazine adverse effects (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms) and GI symptoms; consider using lowest effective NSAID dose with gastroprotection or alternative analgesic.
